sloka: कण्ठे बद्ध्वा दशग्रीवं प्रमदा रक्तवासिना ।काली कर्दमलिप्ताङ्गी दिशं याम्यां प्रकर्षति ।। ५.२७.२८।।।।
transliteration: kaṇṭhe baddhvā daśagrīvaṁ pramadā raktavāsinā ।kālī kardamaliptāṅgī diśaṁ yāmyāṁ prakarṣati ।। 5.27.28।।।।

translations.english: A dark woman clad in red, body smeared with wet mud was seen dragging the ten-necked Ravana by his neck towards the abode of Yama in the southerly direction.
